entry_points.text: Native control resolves descriptors with security checks, tries generic dispatch then filesystem fallback; compat adds pointer adaptation with normalized failures.
Dentry operations expose only revalidation; directory inode vectors add permission, attribute, xattr, mkdir, rmdir and rename with active and operation validation.
Proc descriptor and lock status formatters serve as sequence show handlers rendering position, flags, mount, inode and per-lock family, type and state lines.

exports.text: Space handling checks writable open, kind, range and flags, then delegates inside write accounting with modify notice; 32-bit start resolves from SEEK_SET, current or size origin.
Superblock freeze and thaw stage writer drain with filesystem callbacks, share one active reference across holders, and report busy or invalid on dying instances.
Deduplication fans out over many destinations and delegates pairs with REMAP_FILE_DEDUP, recording length and FILE_DEDUPE_RANGE_SAME status with shortening allowance.
In-kernel read serves regular files only, denies writes across copy, enforces pre and post security for whole-file reads, and adapts path and descriptor handles.
Kernfs naming resolves single names and full paths with root defaults, while parent and name searches take references under read protection and return null when absent.
Kernfs visibility toggles hidden state for non-directories, self removal and creation attach directories with cleanup on failure, and empty directories init with root ownership.
Descriptor lock reporting walks flock, POSIX and lease sets for an inode and emits only entries matching the given file and owner.

hazards.text: Space hazards include range wrap, maxima breach, unsuitable kind, protected or swap use, stale authorization, missing handler and notice even without size change.
Freeze hazards include dying instances, busy contention, sync or callback failure with rollback to idle plus wakeup and release, and thaw failure restoring hold.
Mutation fails without operation tables or on inactive nodes; rename rejects flags, root moves, collisions, invariant parents, empty targets and allocation failure.
Lock display translates owners into viewer namespace with zero when gone or invisible, distinguishing access, description, POSIX, flock, lease, delegation, breaking and active states.
Size violations report file-too-large, malformed requests invalid argument, allocation failures out-of-memory, short whole-file transfers input-output error, and duplicates already-exists.
External dependencies cited here are owned outside this dossier; their internals are not described.

invariants.text: Freeze authorization separates FREEZE_HOLDER_KERNEL and FREEZE_HOLDER_USERSPACE counts, permits reentry only with nesting allowance, and gates ownership on matching tokens.
Dedupe destination authorization follows admin, writable open, ownership or write permission; compat reuses generic dispatch with FS_IOC32_GETFLAGS conversion and normalized replies.
Central dispatch covers FIOCLEX, FIFREEZE and FICLONE with nonblock, async, size, extent, clone, dedupe, flags, xattr and reservation commands; file leftovers go to file logic.
Ordering hashes exclude low and extreme values; siblings insert into a per-directory tree with duplicate rejection and directory accounting under attribute lock.
Depth counts parents toward an ancestor; identifier lookup validates full equality, requires activation plus live reference, and returns with protection dropped or null.
Inode refresh copies mode always and ownership plus times only with explicit attributes, recomputes directory links, and new inodes attach node reference and specialize by type.
Directory emission walks dots before hashed entries with type masking; cached positions validate activity, parent and hash before reuse.
Reported allocation is shifted block tally plus residual bytes observed atomically under short protection.

locks.text: Freeze exclusion uses progressive writer guards with killable wait that drops ownership, waits on frozen change, then reacquires and reevaluates.
Diagnostic print and path walk share one bounded buffer serialized by an interrupt-saving spinlock; naming holds read protection plus rename read lock when needed.
Structural guard uses write for addition and read for revalidation; directory timestamp and accounting nest the attribute write lock inside.
Sequence handling nests per-file mutex outside the active reference and releases active before mutex; notify list has its own spin guard.

state_machines.text: Freeze moves idle through write, fault, sync and internal exclusion to complete with read-only shortcut, while thaw returns via callback and staged release with shared holders.
Addition validates namespace and directory parent, hashes, links sibling, stamps parent then activates; activity counter rejects deactivating nodes and wakes waiters at bias.
Lookup hides inactive nodes, materializes inodes, stamps parent revision and splices; revalidation retries protected trees, drops stale negatives, and checks activity, parent, name and namespace.
Self removal lets one caller mark suicidal and remove while losers wait for suicided plus full bias; readdir emits dots then hashed siblings, pinning each and parking at max at end.

structs.text: Freeze state holds stage, optional exclusive owner, separate tallies, and per-level writer exclusion; stages run SB_UNFROZEN through SB_FREEZE_COMPLETE with write, fault and fs levels.
Space controls include FALLOC_FL_KEEP_SIZE and FIBMAP with unshare, zero, punch, collapse and insert variants; dedupe holds source range plus outcome; identity returns length plus value.
Open-node record holds reclamation head, event counter, poll queue, open list and mapped and release counts; notify termination uses the list head address as sentinel.
Empty directories default to world read and search under root with cleared device, size and blocks; positions zero and one select dots with max marking end.
